title: Why Is Weed Control Important in Rooftop Gardening?
content: Weed control is important because weeds absorb plant nutrients and water, which reduces the growth and health of cultivated crops.

title: How Often Should Weeding Be Done in a Rooftop Garden?
content: Weeding should be done regularly, usually 1-2 times a week or whenever weeds begin to appear.

title: How Does Weeding Affect Crop Yield?
content: Regular weeding improves crop yield by ensuring better access to nutrients, water, and space, keeping plants healthy and productive.
